  • Method Details

    • getCategory

      String getCategory()
      Returns the category (type) of this ship.

      Categories correspond to the Discoveries theme names defined in Ship: e.g., "galeao", "fragata", "nau", "caravela", "barca".

      Returns:
      a non-null String representing the ship's category

    • getSize

      Integer getSize()
      Returns the size (number of cells) this ship occupies on the board.
      Returns:
      a positive Integer representing the ship's length in board cells

    • getPositions

      List<IPosition> getPositions()
      Returns all board positions occupied by this ship.
      Returns:
      a non-null, non-empty List of IPosition objects, one per cell the ship covers

    • getPosition

      IPosition getPosition()
      Returns the anchor (reference) position of this ship — the cell used when the ship was placed, typically its top-most or left-most cell depending on bearing.
      Returns:
      the anchor IPosition of this ship; never null

    • getBearing

      Compass getBearing()
      Returns the compass bearing (orientation) of this ship on the board.

      Determines the direction in which the ship extends from its anchor position.

      Returns:
      the Compass direction this ship faces; never null

    • stillFloating

      boolean stillFloating()
      Indicates whether this ship is still afloat.

      A ship sinks when every one of its positions has been hit.

      Returns:
      true if at least one position has not been hit yet; false if all positions have been hit (ship is sunk)

    • getTopMostPos

      int getTopMostPos()
      Returns the row index of the top-most cell occupied by this ship.
      Returns:
      the minimum row index among all of this ship's positions

    • getBottomMostPos

      int getBottomMostPos()
      Returns the row index of the bottom-most cell occupied by this ship.
      Returns:
      the maximum row index among all of this ship's positions

    • getLeftMostPos

      int getLeftMostPos()
      Returns the column index of the left-most cell occupied by this ship.
      Returns:
      the minimum column index among all of this ship's positions

    • getRightMostPos

      int getRightMostPos()
      Returns the column index of the right-most cell occupied by this ship.
      Returns:
      the maximum column index among all of this ship's positions

    • occupies

      boolean occupies(IPosition pos)
      Determines whether this ship occupies the given board position.
      Parameters:
      pos - the IPosition to test; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if this ship covers pos; false otherwise

    • tooCloseTo

      boolean tooCloseTo(IShip other)
      Determines whether this ship is placed too close to another ship, violating the adjacency rule (ships may not touch, including diagonally).

      Delegates to tooCloseTo(IPosition) for each position of other.

      Parameters:
      other - the other IShip to check against; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if any cell of other is adjacent to any cell of this ship; false if the ships are sufficiently spaced apart

    • tooCloseTo

      boolean tooCloseTo(IPosition pos)
      Determines whether this ship is too close to the given board position, violating the adjacency rule.

      A position is considered too close if it is adjacent (including diagonally) to any cell of this ship, as determined by IPosition.isAdjacentTo(IPosition).

      Parameters:
      pos - the IPosition to check; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if pos falls within the exclusion zone of this ship; false otherwise

    • shoot

      void shoot(IPosition pos)
      Registers a shot at the given position.

      If this ship occupies pos, the corresponding cell is marked as hit via IPosition.shoot(). If the position is not covered by this ship, the call has no effect.

      Parameters:
      pos - the IPosition targeted by the shot; must not be null
